section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1975
title: 20 ## Causes of Suicides The total number of suicides reported during 1975 has been classified under different heads and the last category 'other causes' covers the unspecified causes of suicides. The major cause of suicides during 1975 was 'Despair over Dreadful Diseases' (16.4 per cent). The second important cause was 'Quarrel with parents-in law' (9.5 per cent), followed by 'Love Affairs' (6.1 per cent), Quarrel with Spouses (5.9 per cent), 'Poverty' (3.7 per cent), 'Insanity, (2.6 per cent) and 'Failure in examination' (2.3 per cent). The causes comparatively less important were 'dispute over property' (2.1 per cent), 'Unemployment' (1.0 per cent), 'Bankruptcy' (1.0 per cent), 'Deaths of dear persons' (0.8 per cent) and 'Fall in social reputation' (0.7 per cent). The category 'Other causes' accounted for 47.9 per cent of the total suicides registered during 1975. The detailed statistics are presented in Table No. 2.
